Mosaic: grid first

The grid performs musical actions. Norns follows the resolved action, shows its scope and offers focused editing. This library is generated from the machine contract; edit the JSON and Lua sources, not this page.

Canvas replay uses approximate browser font metrics. Native framebuffer layout and behavior acceptance remain implementation gates. These are executable drawing commands, not screenshots.
